changelog.change: One fact per session; sessions always teach the FIRST incomplete fact in display order
changelog.before: v006.10 ended the session only when the LAST fact finished its scaffold; mid-capsule fact completion flowed straight to the next fact's TEACH in the same session (action advance_fact), and a restored session resumed at the saved position even when earlier facts had been skipped — teaching looked out-of-order and skipped facts never returned.
changelog.after: Every fact completion ends the session: _advance_fact marks the finished fact scaffold_complete, primes the next incomplete fact (display order) at TEACH, sets practice_complete_end, and returns action fact_complete_end (or _end_session_after_practice/EVIDENCE when none remain). restore() clears the end flag AND heals the position to the first incomplete fact in teaching mode, so skipped facts are picked back up in order (or primes EVIDENCE when everything is done). The greeting builder now sources remaining facts from the engine (remaining_fact_texts) instead of report-card facts_taught, removing the prompt-vs-engine split brain. Rows whose action was advance_fact now carry fact_complete_end. Covered by TestPracticeCompletesSession + TestOneFactPerSession.

changelog.change: Learning-system redesign: a session ends when practice ends — EVIDENCE never runs in the same session as teaching
changelog.before: When the last fact of the last batch finished its TEACH<->TRY scaffold, _advance_batch flowed straight into _start_evidence and the EVIDENCE questions ran in the same session.
changelog.after: When the last batch completes, _advance_batch calls _end_session_after_practice: the EVIDENCE state is primed (COLLECT, full-capsule queue) but the transition returns action practice_complete_end and should_end_session() becomes true, so the session wraps up after practice. restore() clears the flag, so the NEXT session resumes directly in EVIDENCE (the greeting's all-facts-taught path) and runs the final check -> CAPSULE_COMPLETE. The per-session journey is now RECALL (returning students) -> TEACH -> TRY. Covered by TestPracticeCompletesSession.

changelog.change: Learning-system redesign: remove the CHECK and CHECK_REMEDIATION phases entirely
changelog.before: Each batch of facts ran a TEACH<->TRY scaffold per fact, then a per-batch CHECK micro-assessment (with a CHECK_REMEDIATION loop on failures) before advancing; EVIDENCE was the final capsule-wide assessment.
changelog.after: Each fact is just TEACH<->TRY and then flows straight to the next fact; the single closing EVIDENCE step over the whole capsule is now the only assessment gate. CHECK/CHECK_REMEDIATION removed from taxonomy.valid_per_phase and all their transition rows deleted; the batch-complete path (_advance_fact -> _advance_batch) now leads directly to the next batch or EVIDENCE. RECALL is unchanged.

changelog.change: ADO-89: extend the EVIDENCE non-answer wait-guard to the evidence_followup second-chance sub-state
changelog.before: v006.5 made CHECK/EVIDENCE COLLECT non-answer types wait no-ops, but the evidence_followup arm still hit an else-branch that marked the fact FAILED on a clarifying question during the partial-correct second chance — so the EVIDENCE non-answer rows (condition:any -> wait) were inaccurate for that sub-state.
changelog.after: non-answer types (question/confirmation/teaching/off_topic) during evidence_followup are now wait no-ops that preserve the follow-up; the condition:any EVIDENCE wait rows are now accurate for all sub-states. Covered by test_evidence_followup_does_not_fail_facts_on_non_answer_types.

changelog.change: ADO #88: encode the ADO #26 flag-gated transitions (first flags!={} rows / the flag matrix)
changelog.before: Contract encoded only the flags-off (production-default) behavior; TEACH_SIGNAL_FIX and TRY_HINT engine paths were unguarded.
changelog.after: Added TEACH_SIGNAL_FIX rows (correct/partially_correct during TEACH advance the scaffold; the 2-turn camping diagnostic -> teach_checkpoint -> engagement_guided_try) and TRY_HINT rows (student_wants_hint -> try_hint / hint_cap_reached), plus the flag-off counterparts. Added student_correct/student_partially_correct to TEACH taxonomy. Golden test now drives flag-on rows via _apply_flags.

changelog.change: Fix two TEACH transcription errors found by the behavioral golden test (Task 4)
changelog.after: condition corrected to 'scaffold_next_is_TEACH' — the engine only emits scaffold_teach_continue when the next scaffold step is another TEACH (default [TEACH,TRY] yields scaffold_to_try). The scaffold_next_is_TRY / scaffold_exhausted variants were already separate rows.

changelog.change: Export contract to git; make CHECK/EVIDENCE non-answer types explicit (was silent FAILED)
changelog.before: CHECK/EVIDENCE else-branch marked any non-answer itype (question, confirmation, teaching, off_topic) FAILED
changelog.after: non-answer types are no-ops (action=wait) in CHECK/EVIDENCE; only answer types set results
